categories.main_business_segments: Thunder Software Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on intelligent operating system products and technologies, primarily serving the intelligent automotive, intelligent software, and intelligent IoT sectors. Key business lines include intelligent automotive systems, intelligent software solutions, and intelligent IoT products, with offerings spanning software development, technical services, software licensing, and integrated hardware-software products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages intelligent operating system technology as its core, emphasizing AI integration, edge computing, cloud computing, and IoT. It develops native intelligent vehicle operating systems (Drip OS), AI-powered robotics platforms, AI glasses, mixed reality (MR), AI PCs, and AI smartphones. The company employs modular software architectures, middleware, and AI model fusion techniques to enable flexible deployment across heterogeneous chip platforms and cloud-edge hybrid architectures.
categories.primary_customers_markets: ThunderSoft serves global automotive manufacturers, industrial robotics companies, smart device manufacturers, and software developers. Its products target intelligent vehicles (including smart cockpits and autonomous driving), industrial mobile robots, AI-enabled consumer electronics such as AI glasses and smartphones, and enterprise video conferencing solutions. The company’s customer base spans automotive OEMs, IoT device makers, and technology integrators worldwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with R&D centers and business presence in 16 countries or regions, including China, the United States, Japan, Europe, and Southeast Asia. Major revenue contributions come from China, Europe, the US, and Japan, with increasing overseas sales growth. It maintains subsidiaries and joint ventures across Asia, Europe, and North America to support local markets and global clients.
categories.supply_chain_position: ThunderSoft operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the software and intelligent hardware supply chain. It develops and licenses core software IP, provides technical services and solutions, and sells integrated software-hardware products to OEMs and system integrators. The company acts as a technology enabler and solution provider rather than a raw material supplier or end consumer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing intelligent operating systems and edge AI capabilities, particularly for smart vehicles, robotics, and intelligent terminals. Key R&D initiatives include developing the Drip OS vehicle operating system, edge computing stations, extended reality (XR) platforms, distributed computing networks, and AI-native HMI tools like Kanzi. It emphasizes hybrid AI architectures combining cloud and edge intelligence and deep integration of AI large models for automotive and IoT applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through a combination of software licensing (IP authorization fees based on usage or product shipments), software development and technical services (customized software design, support, and maintenance), and sales of integrated software-hardware products. The company operates primarily on a direct sales model, with revenues recognized upon delivery and acceptance of software or services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ThunderSoft positions itself as a leading provider of intelligent operating systems and edge AI solutions, particularly in the automotive and IoT sectors. It competes with global software and technology firms offering automotive OS, AI platforms, and embedded systems. Strategic partnerships with major chipmakers and cloud providers, along with joint ventures with automotive groups like Volkswagen’s CARIAD, strengthen its competitive positioning.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 5.38 billion, representing a 2.72% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 407 million, a 12.6% decrease from the previous year, impacted by increased R&D investment and margin pressures. The company’s total assets reached RMB 12.5 billion, with steady growth in overseas revenue segments. The firm maintains a strong R&D intensity, investing nearly 30% of revenue in research and development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ThunderSoft emphasizes its comprehensive intelligent operating system technology combined with deep AI integration as its core competitive advantage. Its Drip OS offers a neutral, open, and flexible platform supporting diverse chip architectures and global automotive ecosystems. The company’s multi-agent AI collaboration, hybrid cloud-edge AI architecture, and extensive ecosystem partnerships enable differentiated, real-time, privacy-protecting intelligent experiences across vehicles, robots, and smart terminals. Its global R&D footprint and full-stack solutions provide customers with efficient, customizable, and innovative intelligent software and hardware platforms.
